pictures.name: SN1-Desert-Camp
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. Early morning in a vast desert valley at the foot of a tall rugged granite mountain. A huge camp of simple tents stretches out; freed slaves in plain wool robes of brown, ochre and faded blue wash clothes in basins and hang them to dry, while a line of stones marks a boundary at the mountain’s base. In the middle, a young mother in an ochre head cloth looks up at the peak. Pale gold dawn, deep blue shadows.

pictures.name: SN2-Thunder-Cloud
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. The same desert valley on the third morning. A thick dark cloud covers the top of the tall granite mountain, lit from within by flashes of lightning, smoke rising. The people of the camp in plain wool robes stand together at the boundary stones, looking up in awe, some holding each other’s arms, cloaks blowing. No figure in the cloud, only light and storm. Dramatic but reverent.

pictures.name: SN3-Into-The-Cloud
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. The tall granite mountain wrapped in thick glowing cloud, golden light shining from within the cloud with no figure in it. Far up the rocky slope, Moses, a tiny far-off figure in a dark robe with a staff, seen only from behind or far away, climbs into the cloud. Far below, the crowd waits at the foot of the mountain, small. Majestic, holy, quiet.

pictures.name: SN4-The-Answer
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. At the foot of the mountain beside a simple altar of stacked stones and twelve standing stone pillars, Moses, a tiny far-off figure in a dark robe with a staff, seen only from behind or far away, stands far away reading from a scroll. In the middle of the frame, the great crowd in plain wool robes answers together, many hands raised, faces lit with hope and resolve: the young mother in an ochre head cloth, an old man, a young couple. Warm gold morning light.

Above the crowd at the foot of the glowing mountain, luminous angels made of soft golden light, their faces veiled in brightness, gently set two delicate crowns of light on the heads of the people. The young mother in an ochre head cloth in the middle looks up in wonder as two glowing crowns rest above her. Dreamlike, tender, deep blue sky with gold.
